metric: replacement follower initialization to applied fixed reference index

workload.durability: checksummed files; fsync before atomic rename; parent directory fsync

environment.hardware: MacBook Air, Apple M2 8-core, 8 GB memory

limitations: This benchmark measures in-process follower initialization with a synthetic leader heartbeat; it excludes OS process launch and election time.
The healthy majority's first post-restart client commit and full-cluster convergence are separate metrics and are not measured here.
